chunks: And from him, from Saif ibn Umaira, from Bakr ibn Muhammad al-Azdi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The emergence of the three: the Khurasani, the Sufyani, and the Yamani, in one year, in one month, on one day. Among them, no standard is more guiding than the standard of the Yamani, for he summons to the truth.

key_terms.السُّفْيَانِي: The Sufyani, a tyrannical figure who will emerge from Syria
key_terms.الْخُرَاسَانِي: The Khurasani, one of the three major eschatological figures
key_terms.الْيَمَانِي: The Yamani, a guiding figure who will call to the truth
key_terms.رَايَة: Standard or flag, symbolizing leadership or guidance
key_terms.يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ: Summons to the truth, indicating the Yamani's role in guiding people

ai.seo_question: Who are the three figures that will emerge simultaneously before the reappearance of Imam Mahdi?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration to emphasize the precise temporal convergence of the Sufyani, Khurasani, and Yamani, marking a critical juncture in the signs preceding the Reappearance. The Yamani is distinguished as the most guiding figure ('ahtā al-riyāh'), serving as a beacon of truth who rallies supporters to the Imam, contrasting with the other two whose roles are more defined by their specific regions and actions.
